definitions.required_angle: For each accepted row, take the geodesic angle from each of the three normalized base-scale descriptors to the normalized mean retained teacher descriptor, then average the three angles.
definitions.base_reliability: semantic_confidence stored in the frozen base descriptor, indexed by its immutable global_rows.
definitions.teacher_view_context_resultant: Norm of the arithmetic mean of normalized retained teacher-view descriptors. This is an explicitly posthoc source-only exploratory statistic, not a preregistered O0-O4 metric.
definitions.reliability_strata: The 20% and 40% empirical quantiles are retained; duplicate upper quantiles caused by the mass at semantic_confidence=1 are collapsed, with the exact maximum reported separately.
definitions.context_strata: Five empirical quantile intervals, left-open except for the first interval.

base_reliability.monotonicity_judgment: strong inverse association: all four tie-aware strata decrease monotonically, and all three scale-wise Spearman coefficients are below -0.58

teacher_view_context_resultant.monotonicity_judgment: no useful monotonic support: the global association is near zero and the highest quintile reverses the preceding mean-angle trend

o0_o4_gain_attribution.interpretation: O1 already captures about 92.27% of the full O4 fixed-mIoU gain, so the fixed 0.15-radian cap is not the first-order bottleneck for fixed mIoU. The cap remains relevant to ranking/calibration because O1 captures only about 46.24% of the O4 AP gain.

method_decision.supported: Use the frozen base semantic_confidence, not teacher-view context resultant, as a source-only conditioning signal for angular capacity when targeting AP/ranking and calibration.
method_decision.not_supported: Do not use teacher-view context resultant as the controller, and do not claim that simply enlarging the 0.15-radian cap is the primary route to higher fixed-mIoU.
method_decision.priority: The next implementation should couple reliability-conditioned residual capacity with query-response/listwise sibling-negative calibration; a larger angle budget alone is insufficient.
